session.platform: Windows Chrome WebGL ANGLE RTX 4090 Direct3D11

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Normal forward movement stops the room with a visible authority tick failure
observations.context: Two-player Rev5 online room after the host holds forward for three seconds from the west spawn
observations.action: Hold W from the authoritative spawn-facing camera
observations.expectation: Traverse into Press Hall while the 20 Hz room continues normally
observations.actual: Frames 02 through 04 display ROOM_TICK_FAILED because movement authority tick is outside the current authority tick range, and the arena state stops advancing.
observations.playerConsequence: A basic movement input can halt the match and replaces combat feedback with a developer error.
reproduction: Run capture-g5-inkfall-visual-continuity.mjs with --renderer=hardware from clean commit 941a1f3
Join host and guest on the Rev5 profile
hypotheses: An earlier authority tick throws after mutating one player but before committing the room tick
A later timer restart exposes the partially advanced movement state as the visible secondary failure
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Log the first runTimer exception with server tick and player movement ticks, then reproduce the same two-client three-second input.
observations.recommendedOutcome: One failed tick must never partially mutate the room, normal forward traversal must sustain the room, and raw authority errors must never appear in the player HUD.

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: The intended spawn egress loses more than three meters of elevation
observations.context: West spawn_w_press_a to the first Press Hall capture position
observations.action: Advance along the corrected 53 degree spawn yaw
observations.expectation: Remain on a clearly supported route toward the first egress waypoint
observations.actual: The authoritative position moves 8.789 m east and 8.023 m north but falls from y=0 to y=-3.259 m.
observations.playerConsequence: The route presented as the primary spawn exit behaves like an unsupported gap or mismatched visual/collision surface.
reproduction: Read joinedPositionMm and pressApproachPositionMm in focused-visual-capture.json
Compare the y coordinates and frame 02
hypotheses: The route waypoint is not backed by continuous authoritative floor collision
Render-only Press Hall surfaces do not align with the Rev3 collision fixture
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Trace the exact capsule path against the 339 colliders and render a collision-versus-art overlay at the first drop.
observations.recommendedOutcome: A player can leave every spawn on continuous supported collision with visual surfaces aligned to authority.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Press Hall remains dominated by black crush and an overhead slab silhouette
observations.context: Hardware-rendered spawn and Press Hall frames at 1440x900
observations.action: Scan the center view for floor, ceiling, cover, and route hierarchy
observations.expectation: Readable industrial materials, deliberate ceiling clearance, and distinct combat lanes
observations.actual: Large connected regions render near-black, the upper half of frames 02 through 04 is a flat black mass, and thin hanging members visually collide with the ceiling field.
observations.playerConsequence: Depth, cover, head clearance, and enemy silhouettes cannot be read reliably.
reproduction: Open all four hardware screenshots at native size
Compare foreground, midground, and ceiling value separation
hypotheses: The review GLB uses underlit or near-black material values without sufficient environment fill
One ceiling or containment mesh is oversized or placed below the intended player envelope
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Capture material-ID, unlit, collision-overlay, and side-section views at the failed position.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Floors, cover, ceiling, portal, and character silhouettes remain immediately legible under normal hardware rendering.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: The live rifle is still a procedural blockout with no hands or arms
observations.context: All four normal player-eye frames with slot 1 equipped
observations.action: Inspect the weapon silhouette, grips, muzzle, and body contact
observations.expectation: Authored gloves and arms holding a proportioned rifle with a clear muzzle origin
observations.actual: Rectangular masses form the rifle, no hands or forearms are visible, and the lower-right silhouette reads as an unfinished prototype.
observations.playerConsequence: The most persistent first-person object lacks physical ownership and makes every combat action feel unfinished.
hypotheses: The production route still binds the procedural first-person weapon family
No accepted Assault arms-and-rifle package has been integrated
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inventory the live first-person scene graph and compare it with the earlier Blender weapon candidates.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Integrate one provenance-safe Assault rifle and gloved arm rig with grip, muzzle, recoil, reload, swap, and ADS contact.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Diagnostics are hidden, but a raw authority exception still becomes player-facing UI
observations.context: Normal online route without the debug query
observations.action: Play after the room tick fault
observations.expectation: A restrained recoverable connection state or match interruption message
observations.actual: The former diagnostics drawer is absent, but an internal ROOM_TICK_FAILED validation message appears in a large red banner across the combat view.
observations.playerConsequence: Implementation details break immersion and provide no actionable recovery path.
reproduction: Read the red center-bottom error banner
hypotheses: The client maps authority protocol errors directly to debug-oriented copy
No player-safe fatal room state exists
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inject each fatal room error in a UI harness and review the player-facing state and recovery action.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Log technical detail privately while showing concise player-safe reconnect or return-to-lobby guidance.

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: Enemy model, role silhouette, animation, and weapon contact remain unassessable
observations.context: Two isolated authoritative player contexts existed, but no opponent appears in the packet
observations.action: Look for the remote player at near, mid, and far distance
observations.expectation: Controlled enemy views showing locomotion and combat contact
observations.actual: No frame contains the remote player, and the room fault prevents the intended multi-angle traversal.
observations.playerConsequence: Third-person model and animation acceptance remain at zero human proof.
hypotheses: The capture route does not stage the guest in the host camera envelope
The room fault prevents the later encounter setup
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: After movement stability, stage a live opponent at 5 m, 20 m, and 40 m and record locomotion, fire, hit, death, and respawn.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Provide player-eye opponent evidence before any model, helmet, role, or animation acceptance claim.
